card.name: Just before newborn age and timing numbers
card.fires_on: The space or small word right before a number in a time span or section number, often in newborn, infant or pregnancy warnings. Also fires on a few joining words and word starts in the same kind of text.

modes.label: Before age or time numbers
modes.description: The blank before a number giving infant age or a time window.

modes.label: Inside numbers and section refs
modes.description: A digit or point within a numeric reference or chemical name.

modes.label: Linking words in neonatal warnings
modes.description: A joining word or word start in a sentence about neonatal effects.
modes.example: fetal or neonatal jaundice<< and>> thrombocytopenia.
